errors.quote: The pair $X_a\to Y_a$ has inverse kernels, which $C=iZC^{-1}Z$ with $Z=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1)$ turns into $C,$ so every role carries $C^{\otimes m}.$
errors.problem: The network alone does not deliver $C^{\otimes m}$ on every role. On $X_a\to Y_a$ the endpoint operator is $C^{-1}$ only on the 27 coordinates of $\operatorname{supp}(u_a)$ and $C$ elsewhere. The identity turns these factors into $C$ only after applying $Z_{a,k}$ before the network at $X_a$ and $i^{27k}Z_{a,k}$ after it at $Y_a$. The $Y_a\to X_a$ route also carries the sign $-1$ of the scalar exchange $(X,Y)\mapsto(-Y,X)$, which is removed by negating the physical $X$ outputs. The paper's Proposition asserts $C^{\otimes m}$ only 'after source and sink diagonal corrections, and undoing the signed bank exchange'; the page drops both qualifiers.

errors.quote: where $W$ counts wires and $m$ is the label dimension
errors.problem: $m=h^3$ is the dimension of the ambient label space $\mathcal F=F^{\otimes3}$; individual labels have dimensions from $0$ to $m$.

errors.quote: Gate labels at times $0$ to $7$ are $B\otimes\langle t_T\rangle,$ $B\otimes F,$ $(B\otimes F)\oplus(R\otimes\langle t_T\rangle),$
errors.problem: The labels (and the stage labels before them) leave out the tensor factor $Q=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$. As written, at stages 1 and 2 they are subspaces of $F^{\otimes j}$, not of $\mathcal F$. The paper: 'All labels are tensored by $Q$ and viewed as subspaces of $\mathcal F$'.

errors.quote: $(B\otimes F)\oplus(R\otimes\langle t_T\rangle),$ ... $(B\otimes F)\oplus(R\otimes\langle t_T\rangle^\perp),$ ... The side edge has residual $R\otimes\langle t_S,t_T\rangle^\perp$
errors.problem: The same $t_T$ is used for every gate, but in the paper $t$ is the indicator of that gate's own physical triple: the time-2 gate is on the $X$ triple and the time-5 gate on the $Y$ triple. Read literally, the time-2 and time-5 labels would not nest, since $t_T\notin t_T^\perp$. 'The side edge' also does not say which of a side wire's edges is meant; it is $2\to5$, joining $t_X$ to $t_Y^\perp$.

The rank equals the absolute dimension change. On the decreasing central edges $3\to4$ the matrix is $-(P_U-P_V)$ with rank equal to the loss $h$; the paper notes that reversing an edge negates the matrix without changing its rank.

errors.quote: For an orthonormal basis $\mathcal K$ of a residual $E,$ $q_V(x)-q_U(x)=\sum_{w\in\mathcal K}|w|\,(w\cdot x\bmod2)\pmod4,$
errors.problem: This holds for an increasing edge $V=U\perp E$. On a decreasing edge the right side is negated, as the paper says ('For a decreasing edge the right side is negated'). The later '$i^{\pm\cdots}$' only hints at this.
